adults.shape: elongated with long snouts and elbowed antennae
adults.metallic_sheen: subtle when newly emerged, dulls with age
adults.comparison: smaller and less abruptly curved snouts than M. janthiniformis

sources: Sing, S.E., De Clerck-Floate, R.A., Randall, C.B., Toševski, I. 2022. Toadflax Biocontrol Agents: History and Ecology in North America. In: Biological Control of Weeds in North America. NAISMA-BCW-2022-29-TOADFLAXES-A.
